snippet.title: Lunar Strike - World Premiere Trailer - FGS Live From gamescom
snippet.description:
The world premiere trailer for Lunar Strike, a narrative adventure and exploration game set at the South Pole of the Moon in the year 2119. The player, a young tech-altered archivist, must survive, explore, and preserve the remnants of a collapsing lunar colony. It'll be coming to PS5 and Xbox Series X/S and PC in 2026.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #lunarstrike
